description: A Minecraft mod for 1.16+. This mod adds new and better barrels, different from the normal vanilla one. The barrels are like an ealry game shulker box as their items can be carried around inside of them!

mods.name: Better Barrels
mods.description: This is a mod which adds new barrels to the game. the barrels act like shulker boxes, however, they don't hold as many items. This means you can have better inventory management early game!
